name: Map Text Encoding
description: Old Chinese and Korean maps keep their texts in a code page (GBK, CP949, Big5), not UTF-8. Choose it for the open project and the editors show those texts readable and write edited ones in it; a text nobody edits keeps its bytes. Shown in the status bar.

map.textEncoding.description: The code page of the map's texts that aren't UTF-8 (old Chinese and Korean maps). The editors show them in it and write edited texts in it; untouched texts keep their bytes. Change Map Text Encoding sets it for the open project.
